page: Amazon Web Services m8gd.medium is a general-purpose instance powered by a dedicated AWS Graviton ARMv9 Neoverse-V2 processor. It features 1 physical core and 1 vCPU running at 2.8 GHz, supported by 64 KB L1d cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 36 MB L3 cache. The hardware configuration includes 4.0 GB of system memory and a bundled 59 GB NVMe SSD local instance store volume. Network connectivity is rated at a baseline speed of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations show average performance in single-core operations, with a stress-ng single-core score of 1693.28 and a Geekbench single-core score of 1735.0. Single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression show average to strong results, with bzip3 reaching 14.02 GB/sec. However, due to its single-core architecture, multi-core and multi-threaded benchmarks are limited, as seen in the Geekbench multi-core score of 1738.0. Memory bandwidth is also constrained, with large block write speeds registering at 11.64 GB/sec.

The m8gd.medium offers a resource-efficient entry point for ARM64-based workloads requiring local NVMe storage without high multi-core processing demands. The instance is suited for lightweight single-threaded tasks, basic web serving, microservices, and development environments that benefit from low-latency local storage but do not require high memory bandwidth or parallel processing power.
